description: This file contains the core implementation of Chart.js version 1.0.1, including chart type definitions (Line, Bar, Doughnut, Pie, PolarArea, Radar), helper functions, and rendering logic for various chart types. It defines classes, methods, and event handling for creating and interacting with different chart visualizations.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Main namespace object for Chart.js, managing chart types, defaults, helpers, and instances.

classes.name: Chart.Point
classes.description: Represents a point in line and radar charts, with methods for drawing and hit detection.

classes.name: Chart.Arc
classes.description: Represents a segment of a pie, doughnut, or polar area chart, with methods for drawing and hit detection.

classes.name: Chart.Rectangle
classes.description: Represents a bar in bar charts, with methods for drawing and hit detection.

classes.name: Chart.Tooltip
classes.description: Handles rendering of tooltips on charts.

classes.name: Chart.MultiTooltip
classes.description: Handles rendering of multi-data point tooltips.

classes.name: Chart.Scale
classes.description: Base class for scales in charts, including linear, logarithmic, and category scales.

classes.name: Chart.RadialScale
classes.description: Specialized scale for radial charts like PolarArea and Radar, managing circular grid lines and labels.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes a chart instance with data and options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the chart, recalculating scales and re-rendering.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the chart on the canvas.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Adds new data points or segments to the chart.

methods.name: removeData
methods.description: Removes data points or segments from the chart.

methods.name: buildScale
methods.description: Constructs the scale object based on data labels and options.

methods.name: getPointsAtEvent
methods.description: Returns data points or segments at the event position for interaction.

methods.name: showTooltip
methods.description: Displays tooltip(s) for active chart elements.
